**Verdict:** Drop "AI" & "project management" (deadweight commodities). Reposition as **Live Capacity & Margin Forecasting** for 25–150 staff agencies.

**Your Unfair Wedge**
PM tools (Asana, ClickUp) are capacity-blind, standalone resource tools (Float, Runn) go stale b/c disconnected from daily work, spreadsheets break every Monday. Own the gap: **live task execution auto-updating 3-wk utilization.**

**1. Upgrade Buyer & ICP**
* **Buyer:** COOs, VPs Delivery/Ops, Founders—not PMs. PMs buy $12 task trackers; execs pay to fix unbilled bench, burnout, hiring timing, & SOW start dates.
* **ICP:** 25–150 headcount (<25 = founder tracks capacity in head; 25+ = spreadsheet collapse).

**2. Pick GTM Architecture (Critical Fork)**
* **Option A — Overlay (Fastest sales cycle):** 2-way sync w/ ClickUp/Asana/Jira. Let creatives keep task tools, sell leadership the forecasting brain. Cuts migration friction ~80%.
* **Option B — All-in-One (Higher ACV, harder close):** Pitch "Capacity-First Agency Ops." Viable *only* if daily task UX rivals incumbents; otherwise team mutiny kills onboarding.

**3. Overhaul Messaging**
* **Cut:** "AI-powered PM for agencies."
* **Hero copy:** "Know who’s free in 3 wks & at what utilization—before you sign the SOW, burn out seniors, or hire."
* **Enemy:** Fragile staffing spreadsheets & blind sales promises.
* **Demote AI to mechanism:** Never lead w/ AI; state outcome ("Design slips 2 days today, 3-wk capacity auto-recalculates").

**4. Product & Pricing Alignment**
* **Bridge Sales + Delivery:** Build/highlight "Tentative Pipeline" toggle—overlay unclosed CRM deals onto 3-wk bench so Sales stops selling phantom capacity.
* **Translate hrs to $:** Show billable utilization % (target 75–85%), $ bench cost, & margin at risk.
* **Reprice:** Ditch $10–$15 PM seat pricing. Charge $25–$45/billable head or headcount tiers; anchor pitch on +5% utilization = $100k+ pure agency profit.
